SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED v3. No imports/AST/build/compiler/tests/lints/GPU/model/process/Git/cleanup or Main-log reads. v1/v2/current worktrees preserved. Before files byte-identical v2 after; v3 is a diagnostic-only delta on existing v1+v2 dependency chain, not whole-file replacement consumer.
Production void wrapper, supplied-queue selector, submit_grouped common leaf kernels/event/backend/GRF gate, all code before diagnostic API and unchanged gemm_rows suffix remain byte-identical v2. CMake byte-identical. Diagnostic backend names remain XMX / joint_matrix (MMA source route) / DP4a, exact selected event, never barrier proxy. Unsupported forced MMA rejects diagnostic rather than presenting fallback as requested-route PASS; no forced XMX addition.
All kernel operands INCLUDING bounds now aligned device-USM. Exact bounds extent17int32=68 bytes, immutable after checked H2D through validation/kernel/drain. No host-USM/shared-USM kernel bounds read. Host initialization bounds[17] and fixed validation_scratch[17], as well as host X/W/Y vectors, live outside try through exception catch/drain. Validator checks diagnostic queue identity/profiling/inorder, device-USM bounds identity, exact scratch17, finite rows1..16*maxrows and maxrows1..512; actual device contents are checked-D2H read into caller-owned scratch, eventwait/queuewait/async latch/complete required before CPU checks. Origin0/terminal==allocatedrows/nonnegative monotonic/groupcount<=maxrows checked. It returns a privately constructed validation object binding exact queue/devicepointer/row/max geometry. Diagnostic launch accepts that object and samequeue/geometry; hostmirror alone cannot construct it. Bench also compares actual D2H contents to initialized geometry before launch. Immutability is caller contract: no concurrent mutation on any queue/host; copying validation does not extend buffer lifetime, and pointer APIs cannot infer allocation extents. API never creates temporary async destinations. Caller source extents/pointer ownership must remain reviewed.
Bounds validation D2H occurs BEFORE hostsubmit interval/exact kernel enqueue; separately reports bounds_validation_host_us. Initialization H2D now four copies including bounds, each checked complete before validation. Output D2H checked before reference. Same exact leaf kernel event wait/complete/async checks then profiling query requires start_ns>0 and end_ns>start_ns; zero/equal/reversed values cannot printPASS. SYCL timestamps nanoseconds/timebase, no physical-clock accuracy calibration claimed.
Cells per fresh externally owned process: GU1280/K2560 orDown2560/K640, groups16, NT1/8/16/128/129/256/384/512. Actualmax equalsgroup0, other empty/ragged counts retained. 129 tests partial second128tile, 384/512 >256. Separate device requested bytes now includes68bounds, host capacity budget includes hostvectors plus both68byte bounds arrays; each cap remains192MiB and actual individualmaxalloc checks unchanged. Overflow-checked extent multiply/add remains. Cap/actualmax failure returns77 UNAVAILABLE before queue work, never silently expands caps or claimsPASS. Allocation failure remainsFAILED; host capacity may allocate then reject before any GPU commands. Accounting logical allocations excludes runtime/allocator overhead: Main finite RSS cap still necessary. No extra optimization/newtarget/CTest.
Structured indexing all-output double-reference, empty/ragged/groups/tails and16canaries maintained. Original host X/W only used for oracle and completed hostY readback, never hostdereference deviceptr. Dyadic separable fixture deliberately remains limited indexing/store coverage; NOT broad rounding/numerical/quality/full-logit qualification. No extra permissive tolerance/nontrivial rounding arm added without reviewed crossbackend numerical gate. Modeltopk10 unchanged; hypothetical8Kaverage160 not observed route distribution. No production roofline/physicalDMA/model throughput/criticalpath claim. H2D/D2H/validation/wholecell host intervals distinct from deviceevent interval.
Any exception requires successful queue drain before freeing device/host state; failed drain _Exit retains allocations/owners and neverPASS. Fresh Main owner/health/fault/finitewall/CPU/RSS/log/normalclosure gates unchanged. No actual selected backend, kernelprofiling, matrixcapability, timings or correctness have been measured here.
Deployment references: IntelLLVM sourcecheckout /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/intel/llvm/.worktree/toolchain-sycl-v711-b570-20261011 supplied revision504366f4b8; compiler distribution7.1.1 and libSYCL ABI9.0.0 are separate identities. Source checkout is not proof of deployed provider/library behavior. Main must supply compiler/binary/libraries/provider/health/source pins before execution.
